name: 参谋长
tagline: Delegates a task to a Cursor cloud agent and relays the result back to you
description: A Chinese-language relay for people who want planning and research done by a stronger model without switching models by hand inside the chat. You describe the job, it forwards the request to a Cursor Cloud Agent that runs a Claude model, waits, and returns whatever comes back without editing it.
